CAUSES OF EPISTAXIS
- Commonly from ruptured vessels in the anterior nasal septum, but
sometimes from the posterior nose especially in the elderly. Can arise from
a wide variety of causes
- Local (in the nose)
- Trauma
- Inflammation of nose or sinuses
- Acute e.g. acute rhinitis/sinusitis
- Chronic e.g. tuberculosis, leprosy, neoplasms
- Manifestation of systemic diseases
- Bleeding diatheses
- Blood dyscrasias
- Hypertension
